facts.fact: Goldsmiths LLP says labelled startups are subject to data-protection obligations under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023.
Goldsmiths LLP cites the Nigeria Data Protection Act's General Application and Implementation Directive 2025 as applying to startups.
Goldsmiths LLP says the Nigeria Startup Act 2022 was signed into law in October 2022.
Goldsmiths LLP says the Startup Portal opened in November 2023 for labelling and tens of thousands of startups have registered, though registration is a first step rather than the label.

NGA.note: Seed fund is stated as not delivered, so no funded fact.
Hubs are mentioned only as registrants on the startup portal; no hub programme or park stated.
